role: CI guard (make uitest-reset-guard; ci.yml, gates.yml) that every EmuquUITests file that calls `.launch()` puts `-UITests-FreshInstall` inside a `launchArguments` block.
toplevel: set -euo pipefail; exit 66 if the directory is missing. Per file: sed strips whole-line `//` comments and trailing `<ws>//...`; files whose code lacks `.launch()` are skipped. awk prints from any line containing `launchArguments` until a line containing `]`; if `-UITests-FreshInstall` is not in that output the file is listed as missing. Any missing -> list and exit 1; else prints count of launching files (18 at 8d32097). Granularity is per FILE, not per launch: a file passes if any one launchArguments block carries the flag, e.g. DataDeletionUITests.swift:146 sets `app.launchArguments = ["-UITests"] + ...` without the flag while :30 has it. A `launchArguments.append(` line without `]` keeps the awk block open until the next `]` anywhere later in the file.
